clue.text: Low cost generates interest

parts.note: low means base, as in base metals or base motives
a cost or charge is a rate

explanation.surface: A cheap price brings in customers' attention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Interest' reads as curiosity in the surface, but it is the money sense: the central bank's base rate is what sets the interest charged on loans.
explanation.definitionFit: The base rate set by a central bank is the benchmark from which lenders calculate the interest they charge.

clue.text: One requests that garbage be sorted without article

indicators.note: sorted means the letters of garbage are put into a new order
without says one of the letters of garbage is taken away before sorting

parts.note: a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone asks that the rubbish be separated, minus one item.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' takes away an A, the article, from GARBAGE, and 'be sorted' rearranges the remaining GRBAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: A beggar is a person who asks passers-by for money or food.

clue.text: "Baffles" are wooden posts

explanation.surface: Something confusing is said to be timber uprights.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the stumps are the three wooden posts of the wicket.
explanation.definitionFit: A puzzle that baffles someone stumps them; cricket's wicket consists of three upright wooden stakes, the stumps.

clue.text: Odd degree in dance music

parts.note: rum is an old British word for odd or strange
BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a university degree

explanation.surface: A strange qualification found in music for dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: The rumba is a Cuban ballroom dance and the music written for it.

clue.text: Working in stone is a strain

indicators.note: working means the letters of in stone are worked into a new shape

explanation.surface: Labouring with masonry is hard on the body.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Working' rearranges the seven letters of IN STONE.
explanation.definitionFit: Tension and strain are synonyms for the pressure of being stretched or stressed.

clue.text: Plant spies on an accountant

indicators.note: in an across answer one piece put on another follows it

parts.note: an is the indefinite article, A
CA is a chartered accountant
the CIA is the American spy agency

explanation.surface: Agents keep watch over a numbers man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' places the spies after A and CA in this across entry.
explanation.definitionFit: The acacia is a tree or shrub, often thorny, of warm regions.

clue.text: Instruments — and red wines welcomed at home

indicators.note: welcomed says one piece is taken inside another

parts.note: claret is the British name for red Bordeaux wine
in means at home, as in staying in

explanation.surface: Musical instruments and bottles of red are received in the house.
explanation.walkthrough: CLARET is the British name for red Bordeaux; 'welcomed' puts IN inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Clarinets are single-reed woodwind instruments.

clue.text: Ignore defenders making economies

parts.note: to cut someone is to ignore them pointedly
backs are the defending players in football or rugby

explanation.surface: Leaving out the defence to save money.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutbacks are reductions in spending, the savings a government or firm makes.

clue.text: Going with gin, eager to get drunk

indicators.note: getting drunk scrambles things, so the letters of gin and eager are mixed up

explanation.surface: Someone keen to get tipsy on spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get drunk' shuffles GIN and EAGER together.
explanation.definitionFit: Agreeing with someone means going along with their view.

clue.text: Pumpkin eating male? Quite possibly!

indicators.note: eating says one piece takes another inside it

parts.note: a pumpkin is a kind of gourd
a man is a male

explanation.surface: A man tucking into pumpkin is probably a big eater.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface asks whether eating a man stuffed with pumpkin makes one greedy; 'Quite possibly!' flags that the whole clue also serves as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A gourmand is a hearty, often greedy eater, the kind who would eat a whole pumpkin.

clue.text: The minister for sport — a fool!

indicators.note: to fool about is to mess around, so the letters of sport and a are messed about

explanation.surface: The government sports minister is called an idiot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The minister for sport' looks like a cabinet post; 'fool' rearranges SPORT and A, and 'minister' is the church sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastor is a member of the clergy in charge of a congregation, a church minister.

clue.text: Amazed to see silver turn up!

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

indicators.note: in a down answer up says the word go is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a go is a turn, as in it's your go

explanation.surface: Astonished to watch silver rise in value.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns GO around in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Agog means eagerly excited or astonished.

clue.text: A very quiet part of London that's charming

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical mark for very quiet
Ealing is a district of west London

explanation.surface: A peaceful London district that is delightful.
explanation.walkthrough: EALING is a district of west London; PP is the musical mark for very soft.
explanation.definitionFit: Appealing means attractive or delightful.

clue.text: Spitting feathers at unit charge

parts.note: a unit is one, the Roman numeral I
a rate is a charge, as in hourly rate

explanation.surface: Someone furious at what they are charged per item.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spitting feathers' is a British idiom for being very angry.
explanation.definitionFit: Spitting feathers is British slang for being furious.

clue.text: Developed a web page in tabloid

indicators.note: in says the page abbreviation goes inside the paper

parts.note: The Sun is a British tabloid newspaper

explanation.surface: A website story was produced inside a red-top.
explanation.walkthrough: The Sun is a British tabloid. 'web' suggests the internet, but this is a spider's web.
explanation.definitionFit: A spider produces silk to make its web, so it spun one.

clue.text: Invaluable and totally absurd!

explanation.surface: Something beyond price is also utterly ridiculous.
explanation.definitionFit: Priceless means too valuable to have a price, and colloquially hilariously ridiculous.

clue.text: The girl's relations are after good pickled vegetable

indicators.note: after says the girl's relations come behind good

parts.note: her is the possessive for a girl
kin are one's relatives

explanation.surface: A woman's family follow a fine pickle.
explanation.definitionFit: A gherkin is a small cucumber preserved in vinegar.

clue.text: How to supply a pathetic person with fare?

definitions.text: How to supply a pathetic person with fare?

parts.words: How to supply a pathetic person with fare?
parts.note: read cryptically, feeding food to a drip, a feeble person, describes a slow hospital method of administering fluids

explanation.surface: How to give a wimp something to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: A drip is British slang for a feeble, wet person; feeding one fare is the cryptic reading of the medical term.
explanation.definitionFit: A drip feed gives fluid or nutrients slowly through a tube into a vein.

clue.text: These days to be in flight is an adventure

indicators.note: to be in says one piece sits inside another

parts.note: flight means escape, as in taking flight
AD, anno Domini, dates the present era

explanation.surface: Being on the run nowadays is quite an exploit.
explanation.walkthrough: AD (anno Domini) is the present era.
explanation.definitionFit: An escapade is a reckless or daring exploit.

clue.text: Reprieve soldiers with malice

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, are army soldiers
spite is malice

explanation.surface: Troops acting spitefully are let off.
explanation.definitionFit: A respite is a short break or postponement, like a stay of punishment.

clue.text: Trace and return call?

explanation.surface: Following a phone call back.
explanation.definitionFit: An echo can be a faint trace of something; an echo is also a sound coming back.

clue.text: Clean with wood!

parts.note: ash is a tree and its timber

explanation.surface: Polishing something using timber.
explanation.definitionFit: To wash is to clean with water.

clue.text: Guards study during battles

indicators.note: during says the study sits within the battles

parts.note: wars are battles
a den is a private study room

explanation.surface: Sentries reading up while fighting rages.
explanation.definitionFit: Wardens are keepers or custodians who watch over a place or people.

clue.text: Company doctor attending engagement

parts.note: MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification
at means attending, as in at a party

explanation.surface: A firm's medic going to a betrothal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'engagement' suggests a betrothal, but it is a military engagement.
explanation.definitionFit: An engagement in the military sense is a battle or fight.

clue.text: Execute English ambassador in poor surroundings

indicators.note: surroundings says the poor piece goes around the others

parts.note: bad means poor in quality
HE, His Excellency, is an ambassador's title

explanation.surface: Put an English envoy to death in grim conditions.
explanation.walkthrough: HE (His Excellency) is how an ambassador is styled.
explanation.definitionFit: To behead someone is to execute them by cutting off the head.

clue.text: Egghead after design for jet

indicators.note: after says the egg's head comes behind the design

parts.note: a plan is a design
the head of egg is its first letter, E

explanation.surface: A boffin follows the blueprint for an aircraft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egghead' looks like an intellectual; read as egg's head it gives E.
explanation.definitionFit: A jet is an aircraft, an aeroplane.

clue.text: Chose poor design for star tabloid feature

indicators.note: design means the letters of chose poor are reshaped to a new plan

explanation.surface: A bad layout was picked for a celebrity piece in the paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'star' suggests a celebrity, but it refers to star signs.
explanation.definitionFit: Popular newspapers print a column of predictions based on star signs.

clue.text: Furniture that inspires musical composition?

explanation.surface: Furnishings that move someone to write music.
explanation.definitionFit: A suite is a matching set of furniture, and an instrumental work of several movements.

clue.text: Formidable man-eater held back by coat

indicators.note: back says the contained letters are read in the reverse direction
held says the letters are contained within the words formidable man-eater

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A fearsome predator restrained by a jacket.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft gave 'held back' only to the reversal, leaving the hidden step with no signal; 'held' signals the hidden letters and 'back' turns them, LEMANE read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Enamel is a glossy paint or coating.

clue.text: Free, liberal, English and totally dependable

indicators.note: free means the letters of liberal are released into a new order

explanation.surface: A free-thinking English liberal can be trusted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Free' shuffles the letters of LIBERAL, and E is added at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Reliable means trustworthy, able to be depended on.

clue.text: Fancy dispensary gets rid of pain!

indicators.note: gets rid of says the letters of pain are removed, the rest falling into a new order

explanation.surface: A pharmacy relieves aching.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the letters of PAIN out of DISPENSARY and DSESRY are left, which rearrange to the answer; 'gets rid of' signals the removal.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressy clothes are fancy and smart.

clue.text: Gave permission to see stand being rebuilt

indicators.note: being rebuilt means the letters of see and stand are reconstructed in another order

explanation.surface: Agreed to view a grandstand under reconstruction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being rebuilt' rearranges SEE and STAND together.
explanation.definitionFit: To have assented is to have agreed or consented.
